title: スプリンターズSの後に・頂点賭けて！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Here comes Bamboo Memory! She's pulling ahead of the pack! And she's in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory has crossed the finish line! She's won! Bamboo Memory has won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Holy craaap! Did you see that final spurt?! She left everyone in her dust!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I think she might even have a shot at beating Oguri if they face off in a mile! What I wouldn't give to see that!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What an astounding victory. As expected, I've witnessed the pinnacle of sprints.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now that she's reached the peak at this distance, next is no doubt…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I won…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I did it… I really did it! I won the Sprinters Stakes! I'm the best sprinter there is!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YEEEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Omigosh, Bamboo totes ate and left no crumbs! Seriously, she rocked! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll have to turn up the heat too! A red-hot race sounds downright fire!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it really hit home that I'm the best sprinter today! I mean, I burned so bright out there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And now that I've conquered sprints…
choice_data_list: It's time to conquer the Mile Championship!
It's time to conquer the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I couldn't have said it better myself!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Do you think Oguri's going to run too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all, Oguri Cap is a part of Bamboo Memory's story!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Oguri Cap announces that she'll be racing in the Mile Championship, just like Bamboo Memory was hoping!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As for Bamboo Memory herself…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! That's perfect. Thanks for the help, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've never helped anyone like this before, but I hope I was of some assistance.
choice_data_list: What are you two up to?
What are you two up to?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I wrote a letter challenging Oguri! Yaeno's used to this kind of stuff, so I asked her to look it over for me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You're not the only one who's been waiting for a match between you and Oguri. Chiyono O, Ardan, and I have been hoping for it as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: We believe you have the power to change the narrative that this era belongs to Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Honestly, I don't think I'll be able to pull off anything that impressive.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: There's only one thing I'm bent on doing, and that's for me and Oguri to be rivals forged by battle and destiny!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And I refuse to lose to my rival!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I've got to hurry and get this to Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yup! I actually made plans to meet up with her!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Laterrr!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Straightforward to a fault as always. But that pure heart of yours is precisely why you pursue your dreams so earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You will be at the epicenter of this new era. I truly believe that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hi, Oguri! Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's okay. I just got here. What did you nee—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Here!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A letter? You want me to give this to someone?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! It's for you! It's my challenge to you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm going to beat you at the Mile Championship and become the strongest miler of our generation!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri! I challenge you for the title of the best miler—as your rival!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Um, Bamboo…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Why did you write this letter if you were just going to challenge me directly like this?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Th-that's a good question!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But, it doesn't matter! This isn't about whether I needed to write you a letter or not!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The important thing is that I want to race you in a no-holds-barred battle for the top! This letter's just the physical proof of that!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I understand. I'm looking forward to racing you in the Mile Championship too, so it's nice to know you feel the same.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I accept your challenge, Bamboo Memory. We'll battle for the top…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I'm going to win.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's what I wanted to hear!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But you're not going to beat me! When the dust clears, I'll be the one on top!
